rules.statement: Both write-domain and read-domain resets are assumed already synchronized to their respective clocks externally; the IP contains no reset synchronizer.
The write and read clocks are assumed to be asynchronous to each other.

rules.condition: When the pointer protocol of Section 10.4 is used
rules.statement: The pointer protocol keeps the read data stable, which the CDC waiver and EXC-003 rely on.
o_rd_data shows the storage content at the read pointer while empty; the consumer ignores it when o_empty = 1.

rules.condition: Before both domains have left reset
rules.statement: No FIFO operation (write or read) starts before both write and read domains have left reset.
Both clocks run during the whole software reset; if a clock stops, the handshake waits until it runs again, with no timeout.
